summary: Accept as test-only hardening. The candidate adds no production fix, but its regression directly invokes DecodeCudaGraphRunner._stage_ragged_verify_layout, checks pointer-stable capture buffers, reaches DeepseekV4AttnBackend._resolve_verify_layout, and covers both 32x6 and the independent 32x5 lower-token layout. All candidate tests passed, and all three integration cases failed when staging was independently monkeypatched to a no-op. The recorded base already contains production source identical to the earlier correction candidate in the relevant files, so the original failure was not reproducible as a failing-before state on the prepared base. The exact four-H20 TP4 DeepSeek-V4-Flash CUDA Graph replay remains unexecuted.

tests.what_was_measured: Recorded-base ragged layout helper coverage: 10 tests passed. This showed the prepared base already has passing geometry behavior, not a failing-before reproduction of the original H20 illegal access.

Exact candidate regression at 3bbdf389dd68d4110dafe780d4e9ea90479c97e7: 15 tests passed, including runner staging, 32x5 synthetic padding, stable captured buffer pointers, and DSV4 resolver value flow.

tests.command: Python import of candidate regression with DecodeCudaGraphRunner._stage_ragged_verify_layout monkeypatched to a no-op
tests.what_was_measured: All three candidate integration cases (32x6, 32x5, and DSV4 resolution) raised AssertionError as expected, independently establishing sensitivity to removal of the integration.
On AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950, 32x6 staged to 192 slots with zero nonzero synthetic slots and 32x5 staged with 32 nonzero synthetic slots.

tests.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 independent adversarial geometry probe (inline Python; transcript in raw/adversarial_gpu.log)
tests.what_was_measured: Seven admitted tier-192 layouts (uniform and irregular) preserved live prefixes, summed to 192, kept capture pointers stable, and flowed matching values through the DSV4 resolver; a 210-token over-tier input was rejected.

gpu_execution.evidence: Tensor layout/staging kernels ran and synchronized on one AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950). This is not CUDA/Hopper or TP4 execution.

remaining_counterexamples: The exact four-NVIDIA-H20 TP4 DeepSeek-V4-Flash DSpark compact-ragged CUDA Graph capture and first replay was not executable in the assigned single-gfx950 environment and remains unverified.

The candidate reaches DSV4 layout resolution with mocked mode/parallel state and verifies values, but it does not run actual DSV4 attention metadata construction, compressor/indexer kernels, CUDA Graph replay, or distributed collectives.

The original illegal-memory-access failure cannot be reproduced on recorded base 358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365 because its relevant production source already contains the staging correction; therefore the candidate demonstrates regression sensitivity, not a new full original-issue fix.
remaining_limitations: Assigned hardware is one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 with ROCm 7.2, not four NVIDIA H20 compute-capability-9.0 GPUs with CUDA 13.
DeepSeek-V4-Flash DSpark model weights were unavailable.
No native source changed in the candidate, so a native rebuild was not applicable. The imported SGLang source came from /job/repo/python; Torch came from /opt/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/torch.
